notes: ONE monthly sitemap https://www.eltiempo.com/sitemap-articles-{YYYY}-{MM}.xml (robots.txt declares /sitemap-index.xml, which lists these monthly files back to 1990-01; the index is stale at 2026-09 but 2026-10.xml exists anyway). No per-day sitemap and no dated archive page: /sitemap-articles-YYYY-MM-DD.xml, /archivo/{YYYY}/{MM}/{DD}/ and /hemeroteca all return 403/404 (/archivo?fecha=... is 200 but ignores the date and lists today), so the day split comes from the per-URL <lastmod> (Bogota time, -05:00, = publication/update time), giving 139/285/333 distinct article URLs for 2026-10-10/10-20/09-30. NOTE: the robots.txt '*' group allows us, but its comment header reserves rights against text-and-data-mining and AI use without written permission from Casa Editorial El Tiempo (notificaciones@eltiempo.com).
